title: Yield typed guidance and resume without treating advice as approval
narrative: When a run needs higher-level judgment, start returns an advice yield with a typed question and choices. The driver answers in a later call; the run completes. This is not a human approval interrupt (`fangore_insp_approval_interrupt`) and not an in-process sparse advisor consult (`fangore_insp_sparse_advisor`). Tracks R-IOC-GUIDANCE[^insp-ioc-02].
implementation: `GuidanceRequest` / `GuidanceResponse` / `GraphYield` with kind `advice_requested`; `DurableGraphGenerator.resume` validates request_id, choice schema, and rejects `requested_authority=final_approval` so ordinary advice cannot unlock approval-only mutations.
validation: Harness `cli` via `scenario.yaml`. Hard expects kinds advice_requested then completed, pending cleared, resume count 1.
